result.title: Reducing the Gap Between Spatial and Space-Filling Curve Neighbors in 3D Point Cloud Segmentation
result.comment: Accepted by ECCV2026 Workshop "3rd Workshop on Scalable 3D Scene Generation and Geometric Scene Understanding"
result.summary: As a lightweight and highly accurate method for nearest-neighbor search in 3D point clouds, approaches based on space-filling curves (SFC) have been proposed. However, due to the inherent properties of SFC, a gap arises between proximity relationships along the SFC and those in the original Euclidean space. In this study, we propose a loss function that reduces the influence of this gap. Specifically, we compute the distances between adjacent points along the SFC and train the model to optimize feature similarity between pairs of points that are distant from each other in the original 3D space. We incorporate the proposed method into a high-performing 3D point cloud segmentation model and evaluate its effectiveness on three datasets. The results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms conventional methods on both indoor and outdoor point cloud datasets.

AI.brief_summary: 针对3D点云分割中「空间填充曲线（SFC）近邻」与欧氏空间近邻不一致的间隙，提出一种损失函数，在原始3D空间中相距远但沿SFC相邻的点对上优化特征相似度，并在三个室内外点云数据集上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 该方法用显式目标校正「序列/遍历顺序邻近」与「真实空间邻近」的错配，可能为 LVR 中 latent 相似度受位置、token 顺序与缓存结构影响、以及视觉关系是否保留在内部表示的问题提供可供核查的正则化线索。
